description: Zero-dependency Node.js SDK for Otipi, the SMS, email and OTP login-code API for Israeli (+972) apps, with a free test mode.
rules: Phone numbers must be Israeli mobiles in E.164 (+9725XXXXXXXX). Convert 05X-XXX-XXXX before calling otipi.otp.send.
Keep OTIPI_KEY on the server only (env var, API routes, server actions). Never use it in client components or NEXT_PUBLIC_/VITE_ variables.
sk_test_ keys are free: messages only reach the owner's confirmed numbers (otipi.testRecipients.add/verify, 5 free SMS); others are logged and test_code is returned. sk_live_ sends to anyone.
Login flow: otipi.otp.send({ to, app }) then otipi.otp.verify({ to, code }); sign the user in only when valid is true.
Errors throw OtipiError with .status and stable .code (invalid_recipient, too_many_codes, free_test_sms_used, rate_limited); map them to user messages.
